create_wavegrad_model: create a WaveGradNN vocoder model instance from a config object for waveform generation
run_wavegrad_forward: run the forward pass of WaveGradNN with mel-spectrograms, noised signal, and noise level
build_upsampling_branch: build the upsampling branch of WaveGradNN that transforms mel-spectrograms to waveform features
build_downsampling_branch: build the downsampling branch of WaveGradNN that processes the noised input signal
apply_film_modulation: apply FeatureWiseLinearModulation (FiLM) connections to inject noise level conditioning into WaveGradNN
